summary: Viomi Technology (NASDAQ: VIOT) filed a Form 6-K updating its share repurchase program originally approved on October 24, 2025. The board authorized up to US$20 million in ADS repurchases through December 31, 2027. As of June 30, 2026, the company had repurchased 2.4 million ADSs for US$3.8 million, leaving US$16.2 million available. Repurchases are funded from existing cash reserves. Management remains committed to executing the buyback to return capital to shareholders. The filing is a periodic update on an ongoing open-market repurchase plan, not a tender offer. Watch for continued buyback execution pace and any future authorization increases.
